## Equipment, Uniforms, and Armor
Security personnel, like all personnel on HGI stations, are permitted to wear clothing that makes them comfortable while working, especially during Green Alert. During heightened alert levels, however, security personnel should wear uniform pieces easily identifiable as security.
Cybernetic enhancements that provide Security HUD and flash protection elements are considered to always be equipped.
On **Green Alert**, there are no restrictions or requirements for uniform or equipment for any personnel. Security personnel are recommended, but not required, to have: - Security HUD - Corpsman: Medical HUD, Medical equipment and supplies - Security Technician: Diagnostic HUD, Silicon repair equipment and supplies, Jaws of Life - Flash protection - Clothing with security colors or markings
On **Blue Alert**, the following equipment is required for all security personnel: - Security HUD (except for corpsman and security technician) - Corpsman only: Medical HUD, Medical equipment and supplies - Security Technician only: Diagnostic HUD, Silicon repair equipment and supplies, breaching equipment Security personnel are recommended, but not required, to have: - Clothing with security colors or markings - Body armor or helmet - Flash Protection
On **Red, Gamma, Octarine, and Delta Alert**, the following equipment is required for all security personnel: - Security HUD with flash protection, if available (except for corpsman and security technician) - Flash protection with no HUD is acceptable - Corpsman only: Medical HUD, Medical equipment and supplies, body bags - Security Technician only: Diagnostic HUD, Silicon repair equipment and supplies, breaching equipment, explosive handling equipment - Body armor - Clothing with security colors or markings Security personnel are recommended, but not required, to have: - Helmet
On **Orange or Yellow Alert**, the following equipment is required for all security personnel: - Security HUD (except for corpsman and security technician) - Corpsman only: medical HUD, Medical equipment and supplies, body bags - Security Technician only: diagnostic HUD, Silicon repair equipment and supplies, breaching equipment Security personnel are recommended, but not required, to have: - Helmet - Flash protection - Body armor - Clothing with security colors or markings - Environmental Protection (such as an EVA suit)
